88
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the August 12, 2005/Sravana 21, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions —20
Schemes of National Horticultural
Board
*281. SHRI  MATILAL  SARKAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of horticultural land
in the country, State-wise;
(b) the number of schemes implemented
by the National Horticultural Board
in the country and in the North-Eastern
States;
(c) the percentage of the horticultural
produce processed during the years
2002-03, 2003-04 and 2004-05; and
(d) whether Government are planning
for processing horticultural produce in a
larger quantity to avoid wastage of the
produce?
Sickle Cell disease in Chhattisgarh
*282. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI : Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
almost ten thousand people die in
Chhattisgarh due to Sickle Cell disease;
(b) whether Government would
consider establishing a Sickle Cell Unit in
the State to provide test facilities at all
district centres in Chhattisgarh; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor and what
steps Government are taking to provide
cheap and reliable blood test alongwith the
details of facilities offered till date?
Pampa Action Plan
*283. PROF. P. J. KURIAN: Will the
Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have approved
the Pampa Action Plan to clean and protect
the Pampa river in the State of Kerala;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the present status of the action plan;
and
(d) in how much time the plan is
expected to be implemented fully?

89
Major rivers choked with industrial
effluents
*284. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of major rivers
and their tributaries are choking with
industrial effluents and other pollutants;
(b) if so, what are the details in this
regard and the programmes initiated by
Government to clean the rivers indicating
the amount spent thereon during the last
three years;
(c) whether it is a fact that heavy
discharge of sewage water in the Yamuna
River is creating havoc with the aquatic life
in the river and defeating the River
Conservation Plan; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
corrective steps taken in this regard?
Target for agricultural growth
*285. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have set a
target to increase the annual growth rate of
agricultural production by more than
6.5 per cent of coming years;
(b) if so, the details of measures taken
or proposed to be taken for increasing
growth of agricultural products in the
country; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Medical and Dental colleges
*286. SHRI LALITBHAI MEHTA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of self-financed and
Government medical colleges and dental
colleges in the country, State-wise, and their
intake at 1st year M.B.B.S. level and
1st year of B.D.S.;
(b) whether it is a fact that many more
self-financed medical colleges and dental
colleges are in the pipeline;
(c) if so, the number of proposals
pending with the competent authorities;
and
(d) what is the action plan of his
Ministry for more dental and medical
colleges and to increase their intake?
Agenda of meeting of the National
Commission on Population
*287. SHRI  S.  ANBALAGAN: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the first meeting of the
recently constituted National Commission
on Population was held recently;
(b) if so, the agenda of the meeting and
its outcome thereof;
(c) whether any specific decisions were
taken to control the explosion of population
in the country, if so, the details thereof and
if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether it is a fact that the Prime
Minister announced during the meeting that
the Population Policy of the country does
not encourage incentives and disincentives;
and
(e) if so, the manner in which
Government propose to control  population
without any incentives and disincentives?

90
Displaying extent of pesticides on
labels of food items
†*288. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to refer
to the answer to Unstarred Question 499
given in the Rajya Sabha on the 4th March,
2005 and state:
(a) the reasons for which Government
do not wish to display extent of pesticides
on labels of food items by amending the
Food Adulteration (Prevention) Rules, 1955
keeping in view the concern for health of
the common people;
(b) whether Government are aware that
pesticides have been found exceeding the
prescribed limit

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the August 12, 2005/Sravana 21, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests; Food Processing
Industries; Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 155
Effect of monsoon on agricultural
output
2039. SHRI R. KAMARAJ: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether as per CII report, a further
recovery of agriculture sector with output
forecast of increase by about three per cent
is expected in 2005-06 as compared to one
per cent last year;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the delay
of monsoon had caused immense damage
to agriculture activities and the agricultural
production may decline; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Agricultural reforms
2040. SHRI MOOLCHAND MEENA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Prime Minister has shown
great concern over farm sector growth;
(b) if so, whether Prime Minister
projected a growth of  7 to 8 per cent for
the Tenth Five Year Plan;
(c) whether PM urged to approve and
implement the correctives enunciated in the
Planning Commission's emphasis on
agricultural reforms;
(d) to what extent PM has asked to
take steps to tackle agricultural problems;
(e) to what extent the suggestions made
by PM has fully been acknowledged and
addressed by all Chief Ministers; and
(f) what are the concrete steps and
measures, State Governments have
considered to improve agricultural growth?
Rural godowns
2041. SHRI YASHWANT SINHA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a scheme of construction of
rural godown called "Gramin Bhandaran
Yojana" has been started to create storage
capacity in rural areas;
(b) if so, the date on which it has been
launched and the achievements made, so
far;
(c) what is the subsidy on capital cost
available for such schemes; and

463
(d) in what manner the scheme is
different from the scheme already in
existence?
Assistance to States for infrastructure
projects
2042. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have notified
certain States/UTs for grant of assistance
for investment subsidy on infrastructure
projects under the 'Strengthening/
development of agricultural marketing
infrastructure grading and standardization
Scheme';
(b) if so, the details in this regard and
the criteria for identifying beneficiary
States/UTs;
(c) whether Karnataka would also be
considered for grant of assistance under the
Scheme; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Starvation-free nation
†2043. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have announced its resolution to make the
country a starvation-free and glorious
nation by December, 2007 while the
foodgrain production has declined to 8 per
cent during the last four years and the
population has gone up in the same
proportion; and
(b) if so, the details of effective steps
taken by Government to increase the
foodgrain production and bring down the
population in order to make the nation
starvation-free by year 2007?
Helping debt ridden farmers
2044. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the past
few years, over 4,000 farmers, many from
the cotton and dryland belt of Andhra
Pradesh, Maharashtra, parts of Kerala and
Punjab have killed themselves as they were
trapped in a vicious circle of debt, crop
failure, penury and extreme hopelessness;
(b) whether Government are aware of
the fact that Indian agriculture is getting
increasingly risky, expensive and water
dependent; and
(c) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to help the farmers come out of
their debts?
Spurious Bt. Cotton seeds
2045. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it has come to the notice of
Government that unlicensed Bt. Cotton
seeds have made their way into the market
in a big way; if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether it is a fact that these illicit
Bt. Cotton seeds fail to germinate;
(c) whether cotton farmers are likely to
suffer heavy loss as a result thereof;
(d) the measures taken by Government
to keep a vigil on spurious seeds reaching
the farmers; and
(e) whether illicit Bt. Cotton seed
producers have been identified and any
action taken against them?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

the Minister of AGRICULTURE be

the problems of sugarcane and cotton
